assumptions: A full-motion teacher can already track the target corpus in the simulated character and scene distribution.
User interfaces can be encoded as persistent partial pose, text, terrain, or object constraints with explicit masks and target times.
The deployment remains within the paper's simulated SMPL character setting; robot hardware requires an independent transfer and safety case.
environments: AMASS flat and procedurally irregular terrain evaluation
robots: 69-DoF neutral-shape SMPL simulated character; no humanoid robot hardware

confidence_rationale: The paper reports full/VR tracking, irregular-terrain tasks, 5,000-episode goal-engineered evaluations, and a strong object-interaction ablation where removing structured masking drops success from 96.9% to 0%; official pinned code exposes the sparse masking and learned-prior VAE mechanisms. Confidence is capped because the evidence is simulation-only, some comparison baselines are inherited from prior reports, and current ProtoMotions 3 does not reproduce the complete paper-era text/object configuration.

evidence.locator: Figures 3 and 5, Equations 6-8, Tables 1-6, and Appendix A-B
evidence.note: Defines full-teacher to partial-student distillation, structured masks, learned-prior C-VAE, simulation scale, tracking/task metrics, and the mechanism ablation.
Maps sparse future-pose visibility and learned-prior/residual-encoder inference to pinned official code while preserving the documented paper-versus-refactor differences.

question: 如何用一个物理控制策略同时接受全身参考、稀疏关节、关键帧、文字和物体等不同控制接口？
statement: 在 MaskedMimic 的 69-DoF 仿真 SMPL 角色、AMASS/HumanML3D/SAMP 数据和 Isaac Gym 环境内，先训练完整动作教师，再用学生分布 DAgger、跨时间持续的结构化遮挡和 learned-prior C-VAE 蒸馏，可让一个部分约束策略复用关键帧、稀疏关节、文字与物体接口；Table 6 中移除结构化遮挡后坐具任务成功率从 96.9% 降至 0%，但该证据不构成人形机器人真机或安全关键部署保证。
